### 27. Show the away panel and redirect for partial-day out-of-office entries (issue #104)

*Opened 2026-10-19. Issue #104 was posted by Zach on 2026-10-18 from
`docs/agent/draft-issue-partial-day-ooo.md` (the posted body matches the draft) and is in the Sprint 2
milestone, `effort:medium`, assigned to `zach-short`. It closes the known limit that PR #85 (issue #6,
board row 21) named.*

**Model: Deep. Lane E. Waits on nothing. Work in its own worktree, cut from `origin/main`:**
`git worktree add .claude/worktrees/issue-104 -b feat/issue-104-partial-day-ooo-away origin/main`.
**`short` does not contain PR #85**, so do not build there. wk is off for this repo (no
`~/.wk/cal.diy.toml`), so the worktree is cold: run `yarn` in it and copy `.env` and `.env.appStore`
from the main checkout.

(`gh issue view 104 -R CSCI-435-SE/cal.diy`) in full: its Acceptance Criteria are the contract and its
Technical Notes are a reading of the code. Then read `AGENTS.md`, `agents/rules/performance-dayjs-usage.md`,
`agents/rules/performance-avoid-quadratic.md`, `agents/rules/testing-timezone.md`, `HANDOFF.md`
§Environment, and HANDOFF steps 23 to 28 (how PR #85 was built and reviewed). Session rules, restated
here because this prompt is pasted alone:

- Run `export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/node@22/bin:$PATH"` before any yarn command. Node 26 breaks

- Never run `git commit`, `git push`, `git add -A` or `git add .`. Print one `git add` block with

- `select`, never `include`, in Prisma. No `as any`. `credential.key` never leaves a query.
- `yarn type-check:ci --force` and `yarn lint --force`. Without `--force`, turbo replays a cached green.
- Run tests with `--exclude '**/.claude/**' --exclude '**/.next/**'`. Worktrees under `.claude/` make
  vitest count every test twice, and a stale `apps/web/.next` adds one unhandled error.
- Grep before you say something does not exist. Never use an API or option you have not seen in this
  checkout, and cite the file and line you read.
- Zach must be able to explain every line of the PR. For each change, say what it does in plain words.
- `biome check --write` can reformat lines you did not write. Revert any hunk that is not yours.

  `yarn build`. Zach walks the booking page himself; give him the checklist.
- Talk to Zach in short, plain sentences.

**Why this exists.** Since PR #85, a host can be away for part of a day. The booking page removes those
slots and says nothing, so an attendee sees a gap with no reason and no "Book with" link to the redirect
user. A whole-day entry already shows an away panel with the reason, emoji, note and redirect. This
issue gives a partial-day entry the same panel, in the place in the day where the window falls. Whole
days, holidays, busy times and the API v2 slot responses must not change, and an away slot must stay
unbookable. A wrong answer here can pass every gate: a slot that should be blocked becomes bookable, or
a window lands an hour off near a DST change. That is why this row is Deep.

**What is fixed. Read these before you change anything, and do not reopen them.** Lines are from
`origin/main` at `cc65a9670f` (2026-10-12), checked again on 2026-10-19.

1. **Where partial entries leave the away map.** `calculateOutOfOfficeRanges` skips any entry that is
   not whole-day (`packages/features/availability/lib/getUserAvailability.ts:748`, predicate at
   `packages/features/schedules/lib/date-ranges.ts:228`). Partial entries go to
   `getPartialDayOutOfOfficeRanges` (`date-ranges.ts:248`, called at `getUserAvailability.ts:482`).
2. **Why the slots vanish.** The partial ranges join the busy times (`getUserAvailability.ts:651-657`)
   and are subtracted from both `dateRanges` and `oooExcludedDateRanges` (`:659-660`). A whole-day entry
   stays in `dateRanges`, so its slots are made and then marked away, and leaves only
   `oooExcludedDateRanges`. A partial window must follow that same split.
3. **Booking stays blocked through `oooExcludedDateRanges`.** `ensureAvailableUsers` reads
   `oooExcludedDateRanges` as its date ranges
   (`packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking/ensureAvailableUsers.ts:220`).
4. **Slot marking is per date.** `buildSlotsWithDateRanges` looks up `datesOutOfOffice[YYYY-MM-DD]` in
   the host's zone (`packages/features/schedules/lib/slots.ts:187-192`) and marks every slot that day.
   `IOutOfOfficeData` (`getUserAvailability.ts:214`) holds one entry per date.
5. **The booker assumes away means a whole day.** `AvailableTimes` returns one panel when every slot is
   away (`apps/web/modules/bookings/components/AvailableTimes.tsx:266-268`) and handles only a leading or
   trailing away run after that. `AvailableTimeSlots` judges the day from its first slot
   (`AvailableTimeSlots.tsx:206`).
6. **The DST parse from PR #85 stays.** `wallClockToTimeZone` (`date-ranges.ts:241-246`) fixes a
   one-hour error that `.tz(zone, true)` gives near a DST change. Reuse it for every window edge.
7. **A test reverses on purpose.** `packages/features/availability/lib/getUserAvailability.outOfOffice.timezone.test.ts`
   asserts that a partial entry stays off the away map. Update that case; do not delete it.
8. **API v2 slot output does not change.** Away slots are already filtered there
   (`apps/api/v2/src/modules/slots/slots-2024-09-04/services/slots-output.service.ts:49` and `:119`).
   The issue cites the file without its folder; the 2024-04-15 version of that file has no `away`.
9. **Size.** The issue estimates about 5 code files and 4 test files. If the diff passes 500 lines,
   split it: engine and slots first, booker second (`AGENTS.md`, PR size).

**Do these, in order.**

1. **Make the worktree** (header line), install, copy the env files, and record the gate baselines in
   it: `yarn prisma generate`, `yarn type-check:ci --force`, the three test files from step 6 below.
2. **Get Zach's answers to the questions below before any code.** The data shape depends on them.
3. **Engine.** Keep a partial window in `dateRanges` and subtract it only from
   `oooExcludedDateRanges`, as whole days do (fact 2). Add the window to the away data per the answer on
   two entries in one day. Keep it O(n log n) or better over slots and entries.
4. **Slots.** In `buildSlotsWithDateRanges`, mark a slot away for a partial entry only when it meets the
   overlap rule Zach picks. Leave whole-day marking exactly as it is.
5. **Booker.** In `AvailableTimes`, render one away panel at the first away slot of each run, between
   the slots before and after it, and hide the away slots. Make `AvailableTimeSlots` stop judging the
   day from its first slot alone. Check that `packages/features/calendars/components/DatePicker.tsx:256-266` (the issue's path
   is wrong), `apps/web/modules/schedules/hooks/useNonEmptyScheduleDays.ts:13` and the weekly view
   `apps/web/modules/calendars/weeklyview/components/event/Empty.tsx:66` do not change for a partial window.
